More about how we work

What we do

Six focused service areas.

SEO Strategy

Search strategy built around business objectives, target customers, existing visibility and realistic growth opportunities.

Technical SEO

Technical audits and implementation guidance covering crawlability, indexing, site architecture, performance, metadata, internal linking and structured signals.

Local SEO

Local search optimisation for businesses targeting Nairobi, other Kenyan cities or multiple locations.

SEO Content Strategy

Keyword research, search-intent analysis, content architecture, landing-page planning and ongoing editorial strategy.

Ecommerce SEO

Organic-search optimisation for ecommerce stores, product and category architecture, and commercial search visibility.

SEO Audits

Detailed assessment of technical issues, content gaps, search visibility and opportunities — followed by a prioritised action plan.
